subject.title: [v2026.3.24] Two regressions: browser tabs CLI syntax break + gateway cycling after doctor --fix

question: Should OpenClaw support an explicit pinned daemon runtime path for operators who intentionally use version-manager runtimes, or keep the product direction as system-Node migration plus documented reinstall/doctor guidance?
rationale: The browser half is a bounded compatibility repair, but the remaining Gateway half can become a new CLI/env/operator contract with security and availability implications, so automation should not choose that product boundary alone.

options.title: Keep composite open until both tracks settle
options.body: Review/land or replace the browser fix and decide the daemon runtime-path policy through the existing Gateway runtime-path track before closing this issue.

options.title: Split browser and Gateway follow-up
options.body: Close this issue only after the browser fix lands, then leave Gateway runtime-path policy to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/60612 or a narrower maintainer-sponsored PR.

options.title: Decline explicit runtime pinning
options.body: Keep system Node migration as the supported path and document the reinstall/doctor recovery story instead of adding a new runtime-path contract.

recommendation.title: Keep composite open until both tracks settle
recommendation.body: Review/land or replace the browser fix and decide the daemon runtime-path policy through the existing Gateway runtime-path track before closing this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal spans both the CLI compatibility surface and daemon runtime selection policy.
